layout: One handwritten sheet: centred heading; a three-line parenthetical editor note; three long prose paragraphs, the last unfinished at the page edge. Black main writing and corrections have the same visible ductus; selected words or word parts are underlined in red. Interlinear insertions are for me, possible, journey and thus. The n after out a and the word travel are deleted. No mathematical display, diagram or drawing is present. Archive pencil 9 is at the lower-left corner. Underlines covered in the transcription are a, journey, itself, manifold, him, that, but, ive within provocatively, surrounding, in which, present and stems from. Whole and each supplied half were viewed once, followed by one tight crop for each of four open places.

changes.evidence: The heading ends in the final e of Mathématique; no s follows. Reflexions has no acute accent on its first e, whereas the later series title does.
The small words for me sit above the baseline between thing and is, with the interlinear placement evident. H places their words in the line without marking insertion.

There is no second live a after a wholly deleted an. Possible is below the line, with a connector rising to the gap before alternative.
Travel is visibly crossed through. Journey is above it and has its own red underline. H retains the deletion but omits the insertion state and the underline of journey.

Two distinct parallel arcs have separate lower ends but meet at the top. The image does not decide between two opening parentheses and a single parenthesis retraced; the C doubt is retained rather than a certain single opener as in H.

After that parenthesis the forked stroke is the insertion caret for thus, which stands above; there is no second comma there. The title is delimited by paired raised short strokes, not guillemets. The opening pair is before Pursuing and the closing pair after Stacks on the next line.
Paired raised strokes enclose the subtitle. The first comma is before the closing pair; a separate comma follows the closing parenthesis.

The first word ends in s; no final e is written before the space and two.

The opening mark comprises two touching staggered strokes; the closing mark is two separated short strokes. Naive has the ordinary single i-dot, with no diaeresis.
Two short raised strokes precede new and another pair follows continents; these are double quotes.

notes: The parenthetical note calls the following text a possible alternative version because the photocopy is unclear, and says red underlining records changes whether by Breen or by us.
The first main paragraph presents renewed mature work after a twelve years' silence, with journey replacing travel and thus inserted. The unpunctuated final word life is preserved.

The next paragraph announces two forthcoming volumes under Pursuing Stacks, with the first subtitled The Modelizing Story, and describes a synthesis involving homotopical algebra, (co)homological algebra and topos theory.

The last paragraph names the broader series Réflexions Mathématiques and two new continents; the sheet stops after One stems from. No date or page count is stated; the corner 9 is an archive sheet number.

notation.evidence: A baseline numeral 2, short hyphen and ordinary lowercase stacks are plainly visible.

notation.evidence: Paired raised short strokes enclose all six expressions. Around naive ideas the first pair touches and is staggered, as resolved by the crop.
Each is a single raised stroke, distinct from the paired title quotation strokes.
Two adjoining parallel arcs remain ambiguous in the single tight crop; only one closing parenthesis follows him,.
Heading Reflexions lacks the first acute and Mathématique lacks final s; the later title visibly has the accent and plural. Both Mathématique forms show the e accent.
The red stroke starts after t and ends before l; its extent corresponds to ive.
The enlarged crop shows one ordinary i-dot, not two dots or another accent.

brief_feedback: All text was compared word by word against C and H while viewing the halves, including punctuation, spelling, accents, underlines, and changes of state. The 12 inventory rows cover all five text blocks, four insertions, two deletions, and the archive corner number; the layout field enumerates every underline. Only the deleted n doubt is resolved as a C change; the doubled/retraced opener is retained. H emph versus uline, struck versus deleted, baseline 2 versus math-mode 2, and dash-length TeX spelling are not counted as differences. H supplied final s/e are excluded from the reading as unwritten; its six guillemet pairs are listed as visible quote-shape differences for adjudication. No mathematical proof or calculation is claimed for this prose page.
